question: Will the U.S. lift CAATSA sanctions on Turkey by December 31, 2026?
literal_rule_scope: YES only if the federal government issues a Section231 measure by Dec31 ET that reverses/removes/waives/terminates/suspends US CAATSA penalties on Turkey, SSB or covered Turkish officials, including partial or temporary relief or entity-/individual-level relief. Statement of intent, negotiations, future announcement without issuance, and F-35/NDAA-only changes do not qualify. Case description cites a Reuters Jul7 report of Trump intent; reported intent itself is nonqualifying.
